changelog:
- Initial release of the academic-paper-search skill, providing a step-by-step academic paper search and management workflow.
- Integrates six modular tools for comprehensive literature search, bulk download, monitoring, CNKI advanced search, and citation management.
- Supports multi-database querying (arXiv, PubMed, Semantic Scholar, Google Scholar, IEEE, ACM, Scopus, Web of Science, CNKI).
- Enables bulk downloading, structured indexing, and literature monitoring across key academic platforms.
- Facilitates citation formatting and BibTeX generation for research writing compliance.
- Delivers all results as a consolidated research package including search results, downloaded files, monitoring reports, and standardized reference lists.
summary: Conducts comprehensive academic paper searches across multiple databases, downloads PDFs, monitors new publications, and manages standardized citations.
